body.name: total Borel empirical observable summary
body.construction: For \(N_{t,n}:=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf 1\{T_i=t\}\), set \(\widehat M_{t,n}:=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf 1\{T_i=t\}Z_iX_i^\top/\max\{1,N_{t,n}\}\), \(\widehat N_{t,n}:=\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf 1\{T_i=t\}Y_iZ_iX_i^\top/\max\{1,N_{t,n}\}\), \(\widehat m_{X,n}:=n^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^{n}X_i\), and \(\widehat S_n:=(\widehat M_{0,n},\widehat M_{1,n},\widehat N_{0,n},\widehat N_{1,n},\widehat m_{X,n})\). Both armwise matrices are the zero matrix on \(\{N_{t,n}=0\}\), so \(\widehat S_n\) is a total Borel function of the sample.
